verdict.rationale: Snyk is a SaaS platform with AI features (DeepCode AI, the LLM-driven Remediation Agent), so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack has no documentation of an AI-training opt-out, data-usage controls, or a no-training commitment. The only related item is a community quote about a broad content licence in Snyk's terms, and that shows no way to prevent training use.
